description: TU Delft provides the variables used to calculate Hotterdam physical heat clusters. Native parent metadata describes measured urban heat, modelled surface energy balance and physical city features from satellite images, GIS and three-dimensional models. The custom format field gives values on a one-hectare grid compatible with CBS 100-metre squares. Coverage: 2014. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: The extent excludes Rotterdam harbour. Individual variable names and units are not fully stated in this member. The physical input inventory is distinct from a resulting heat-cluster map. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Hotterdam source explicitly relates these variables and maps to urban surface-energy modelling and regression. Simulation use concerns built-environment heat exposure.
